name: Phil's Bistro Electric Grill
description: Compact and powerful electric grill for balconies and small patios.
longDescription: The Phil's Bistro Electric Grill offers quick heating and precise electronic controls in a space-saving footprint. Ideal for urban apartments and balconies with strict no-flame policies.

name: Phil's Patio Master Electric Grill
description: Versatile mid-sized electric grill with dual-zone heating.
longDescription: Upgrade your backyard setup with the Patio Master. Features independent dual-zone temperature control allowing you to sear steaks on one side while gently warming veggies on the other.

name: Phil's Commercial Pro Electric Grill
description: Premium large-capacity electric grill built with heavy-gauge stainless steel.
longDescription: Designed for serious outdoor entertaining. Features digital precision PID temperature control, integrated meat probes, and heavy-duty porcelain-enameled cast iron grates.

name: Pro Heavy-Duty Grill Tongs
description: Extra-long stainless steel tongs with non-slip silicone grip handle.
longDescription: Keep your hands safe from heat with our 16-inch commercial grade tongs. Includes scalloped edges for secure grip and a locking mechanism for easy storage.

name: Multi-Tool BBQ Spatula
description: Heavy-duty spatula featuring serrated tenderizing edge and built-in bottle opener.
longDescription: The ultimate griller's multi-tool. Made of extra thick stainless steel with a comfortable ergonomic wooden grip and convenient hanging loop.

name: Carving Fork & Meat Prongs
description: Precision carving fork for holding roast, steaks, and poultry firmly in place.
longDescription: Forged stainless steel prongs designed to pierce and grip meats cleanly without tearing. Essential tool for slicing and serving grilled dishes.

name: LED Magnetic Grill Handle Light
description: Ultra-bright weather-resistant LED light with 360-degree rotation.
longDescription: Light up your evening grilling sessions. Features heavy-duty magnetic base and adjustable screw clamp to attach seamlessly to any grill handle.

name: Instant-Read Wireless Meat Thermometer
description: Digital thermometer with Bluetooth phone connectivity and instant 2-second readout.
longDescription: Monitor internal meat temperatures up to 150 feet away using your smartphone. Preset USDA temperature alerts guarantee perfectly cooked meals every time.

name: Bristle-Free Steam Cleaning Brush
description: Safe, wire-free grill cleaner using heavy-duty woven mesh scraper pads.
longDescription: Avoid dangerous loose wire bristles. Uses the natural cleaning power of steam combined with durable stainless mesh to scrub away tough burnt-on grease.

name: Bistro Small All-Weather Grill Cover
description: Heavy-duty 600D waterproof polyester cover with UV protection.
longDescription: Protect your Bistro grill from rain, snow, pollen, and sun damage. Includes side drawstrings and click-close straps for wind security.

name: Patio Master Medium All-Weather Cover
description: Custom-fit cover designed for mid-sized cart-style electric grills.
longDescription: Features air vents to prevent internal moisture buildup and padded handles for quick fitting and removal.

name: Commercial Pro Large All-Weather Cover
description: Maximum protection cover with reinforced double-stitched seams.
longDescription: Engineered for full outdoor exposure. Heavyweight canvas-feel fabric shields your large grill investment all year round.

name: Non-Stick Cast Iron Griddle Plate
description: Reversible pre-seasoned cast iron griddle inserts directly over grill elements.
longDescription: Flat side ideal for pancakes, eggs, and smash burgers; ridged side creates bold steakhouse sear marks.

name: Stainless Steel Kabob Skewers (Set of 8)
description: Flat-blade reusable skewers prevent food from spinning when flipped.
longDescription: Includes 8 food-grade 304 stainless steel skewers and a handy canvas storage pouch. Dishwasher safe.

name: Electric Grill Wood Chip Smoker Box
description: Heavy-gauge stainless steel smoker box to infuse real wood smoke flavor.
longDescription: Hinged lid allows easy wood chip refills while grilling. Specially vented pattern distributes dense smoke over food without igniting flare-ups.

name: Silicone Basting Brush & Bowl Set
description: Stainless steel bowl with heat-resistant silicone basting brush.
longDescription: Perfect for slathering sauces, marinades, and melted butter onto meats. Heat-safe silicone bristles won't shed or warp under heat.

name: Extreme Heat-Resistant Pit Gloves
description: Aramid fiber insulated gloves providing heat resistance up to 1472°F.
longDescription: Handle hot grates, pizza stones, and warm pans with confidence. Non-slip silicone textured palms ensure steady grip on all BBQ gear.

name: Stainless Steel Fish & Veggie Grill Basket
description: Locking wire basket designed for grilling delicate seafood, vegetables, and fruit.
longDescription: Keeps small foods from falling through the grates. Features removable heat-resistant handle for easy closing lid operation.

name: Heavy-Duty Extension Cord (15-Amp / 25ft)
description: Outdoor-rated 12-gauge heavy cord designed to safely power electric grills.
longDescription: Avoid power drops or cord overheating. Weather-proof rubber jacket with lighted end plug indicating active power outlet.

name: Non-Stick Grill Mat Set (Pack of 5)
description: PTFE fiberglass non-stick cooking mats prevent food sticking and drip mess.
longDescription: 100% non-stick surface makes cleanup effortless. Dishwasher safe and reusable hundreds of times per sheet.

name: Meat Shredding Bear Claws (Set of 2)
description: Ergonomic shredding claws for easy pulling of pork, chicken, and beef.
longDescription: Shred smoked meats in seconds without burning your fingers. Crafted from BPA-free high-temperature resistant nylon.

name: Citrus & Degreaser Grill Cleaner Spray
description: Plant-based non-toxic degreaser formulated for stainless steel & enamel surfaces.
longDescription: Breaks down baked-on grease rapidly without harsh chemicals or toxic fumes. Safe on all food-contact cooking zones.

name: Burger Press & Slider Stuffer
description: Non-stick heavy press for making uniform patties, sliders, and stuffed burgers.
longDescription: Create restaurant-style stuffed patties filled with cheese, mushrooms, or bacon. Removable bottom plate makes patty removal seamless.

name: Stainless Steel Replacement Grate & Rib Rack
description: Heavy-duty 8mm thick rod cooking grate with built-in 4-slot rib rack.
longDescription: Dual-purpose cooking grate maximize cooking area. Cook ribs vertically while utilizing remaining grate space for sides.

name: Phil's Master Griller 12-Piece Gift Set
description: Complete grilling accessory gift bundle packaged in aluminum carrying case.
longDescription: Includes tongs, spatula, fork, basting brush, 4 skewers, cleaning brush, and digital probe thermometer in a sleek aluminum gift storage briefcase.
